description: This PHP source file defines the class `FormatWithEmployeeName`, which implements the `ValueFormatter` interface to format values by retrieving an employee's full name using their employee number. It is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the Maintenance Access Strategy for formatting values.

classes.name: FormatWithEmployeeName
classes.description: Implements value formatting by fetching an employee's full name based on employee number, utilizing EmployeeService and decorator pattern.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the full name of an employee given their employee number, or null if not found.
